'''2012 Bespin Regionals Mitch Nieland LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mitch Nieland]] at [[2012 Bespin Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
